products.name: Walk With Gød Tee
products.description: Avant-garde heavyweight architectural tee featuring the signature Purgatory triple-cross chest embroidery and high-definition "WALK WITH GØD" inferno back screenprint. Crafted with reinforced ribbed collar and dropped shoulder geometry.
products.fit_note: Boxy architectural cut · True to size · Model is 5'9" wearing size L
products.care: Cold machine wash inside-out · Hang dry in shade · Do not iron print

products.name: Godspeed Rosary Tee
products.description: Iconic gothic drape tee adorned with full chest oversized rosary bead illustration and sleek vertical "Godspeed" blackletter typography along the lateral seam.
products.fit_note: Relaxed boxy silhouette · True to size · Model is 5'11" wearing size L
products.care: Hand wash or gentle cycle cold · Do not tumble dry · Dry flat

products.name: In Money We Trust Tee
products.description: Raw deconstructed street tee showcasing the archival monetary collage graphics across the chest with bold "ALL WE NEED IS MONEY" graffiti typography across the back.
products.fit_note: Tailored boxy drape · Drop shoulders · Model is 5'8" wearing size M
products.care: Machine wash 30°C · Do not bleach · Iron on reverse side

products.name: Purgatory OG Green Tee
products.description: The foundation of the Purgatory permanent archive. Features the signature forest-green puff print logotype on the chest and contrasting botanical silhouette artwork on the reverse.
products.fit_note: Standard boxy fit · True to size · Model is 5'10" wearing size L
products.care: Cold wash · Line dry · Do not dry clean

products.name: Icons Grid Tee
products.description: Curated 10-portrait cultural icon collage rendered in high-density monochrome plastisol ink on museum-weight cotton jersey. Minimalist clean back panel.
products.fit_note: Oversized drape · Model is 5'7" wearing size S
products.care: Gentle cycle cold · Do not tumble dry · Dry in shade

products.name: Skull Pile Graphic Tee
products.description: High-contrast macabre anatomical skull cluster illustrated across the abdomen with ironic retro digital block typography on the rear panel. Heavyweight hand-feel.
products.fit_note: Boxy streetwear cut · True to size · Model is 6'0" wearing size XL
products.care: Wash cold inside-out · Line dry · Avoid ironing direct on ink
